This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="RJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|mustard-colored]] skin.<ref name="RJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Olega]].<ref name="RJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Revenge / Justice|second episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]].<ref name="RJ" />
